title: Huma HUB esp aimbot fov
features:
Yo. Dropped the heavy GUI from the previous versions because some of you were complaining about FPS drops on low-end PCs. V7.0 is a pure RAW script now. It runs completely in the background with absolutely zero lag.

I also completely rewrote the target scanner and added a custom Raycast Visibility engine.

V7.0 Changelog & Features:

Raycast ESP: Boxes turn GREEN if the enemy is visible, RED if they are behind a wall, and YELLOW when your aimbot locks onto them.

Prediction Aimbot (RMB): Calculates enemy movement velocity (0.045 prediction) so you never miss a running target. Wallbang is fully supported; it locks even if they hide.

On-Screen FOV Slider: No need to edit the code to change your FOV. You can adjust the circle size dynamically from the watermark panel on your screen.

Forced TeamCheck: The scanner completely ignores your teammates. No accidental locks, pure PvP.

Optimized Engine: Trashed the old while wait() loops. This uses an event-based scanner and cached raycast params so your CPU can finally breathe.
